issues.quote: The human plateau began to shift.
Posts flew through feeds like hotcakes
Two hundred thousand viewers instantly jumped to two hundred and fifty.
And then came the time to answer.
*"Do you have kids?"* a stranger asked. *"How do you achieve success when you have four of them?"*
you couldn't answer like that to a follower
